create.name: Open
create.bio:
Open is a mindfulness studio and app from Los Angeles that blends breathwork, guided meditation, movement and sound, usually set to music. Co-founded by the meditation teacher Manoj Dias, it sets out to make practice feel social and sensory rather than silent and solemn, drawing on older contemplative traditions alongside new technology. Its teachers come from mindfulness, yoga and breathwork backgrounds in several countries.

Classes follow three main formats. Meditate pairs a guided sit with light breathing and music; Move adds a flowing, yoga-based sequence treated as moving meditation; and Breathe is a longer, immersive breathwork session. Sessions run from five minutes to an hour and are streamed live or on demand through the iOS app and a web app, with a subscription giving access to the full digital library. In person, Open runs a flagship studio by Venice Beach, where classes are booked with credits and the timetable centres on its signature Move classes. The site also carries a blog with introductory articles on breathwork and meditation written by its teachers.

courses.title: Open Subscription
courses.description: Access to all of Open's digital classes in the app and on the web, live and on demand, from short breathing sessions to hour-long classes. Renews monthly or yearly and can be cancelled at any time.

courses.title: In-Person Class Credits (Venice studio)
courses.description: Credits for classes at Open's studio in Venice, Los Angeles, where the timetable centres on its Move formats of breathwork, music and mindful movement. Single credits, an intro pack and recurring memberships are offered.

free_resources.title: Breathwork for Beginners
free_resources.description: An introductory article by Manoj Dias on what breathwork is and how to begin, with simple techniques to try at home.
